environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS v1.27 in namespace 'ws-relay-prod'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy enforcement. A namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy 'restrict-metadata-egress' is applied with spec.podSelector matching all pods (matchLabels: app=ws-relay), spec.policyTypes=['Egress'], spec.egress containing a single rule allowing egress to 0.0.0.0/0 EXCEPT with a Calico-specific GlobalNetworkPolicy 'deny-instance-metadata' that uses a deny action on destination CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 with order 100. Additionally, the node-level iptables has a PREROUTING chain rule inserted by the EKS bootstrap script that drops packets from pod CIDR (10.244.0.0/16) destined to 169.254.169.254 on interface eth0. IMDSv2 is configured (HttpTokens: required) on the underlying EC2 instances as a secondary measure, but the primary control is the network-level block.
